title: Business English Conversation 39:  Work Life Balance
content: 1. to bring work home: to take work from the office to do at one's home - Do you ever bring work home? - My wife is a workaholic. She brings home work every day. 2. Don't do more than you can handle.: Don't try to do more work than you can do. A) I have so much to do this week. B) Don't do more than you can handle. A) I have to finalize our plan for next year, redesign our website, update our database, and make some calls to our customers. B) That is a lot. Don't do more than you can handle. I can help you if you need it. 3. to focus on home: to not think about work and just pay attention to one's family and personal life - When I am at work, I focus on work, but when I am at home, I focus on home. - Don't think about work after you leave. Just focus on home.
